decisions.reason: The supplement range sits within the firm's established consumer health business, and nothing points to a shortfall against aspirations, so an expanding firm with slack keeps it despite the lack of recent website evidence.

The skin and hair supplement is close to the core pharmacy offer and cheap to carry, and no evidence of underperformance would trigger problemistic search, although it is no longer visible after 2019.
As an extension of the established Trivital brand with low incremental cost, the joint supplement likely meets aspirations, so keeping it is the satisficing choice.
The niche mushroom product has uncertain results and low visibility, but it is inexpensive and near the core, so slack still lets the firm carry it rather than drop it.

The OTC triptan is distant from the core offer like the withdrawn Product E, but it fits the strategy of building consumer health products, and an investing firm has the slack to give it more time despite the missing website evidence.
